summary.goal: Build and maintain baselines from correlated IdeationOutcome + PlanQualitySignal data using EMA and Welford's algorithm. This is the learning core.

acceptance_criteria.description: Triggered by plan_quality_signal_received event (not ideation_outcome_received)
Correlates PlanQualitySignal with matching IdeationOutcome by session_id
Updates baseline metrics with Welford's algorithm: questions_per_plan, versions_before_approval, block_utilization, conversation_turns
Updates specialist_contribution_rates per specialist template (contributed = blocks_created > 0 OR insights_queued > 0)
Uses single pattern 'session_quality' for v1 (not per-topic)
Skips baseline update if no matching IdeationOutcome found for session_id
EMA smoothing factor α=0.1 (same as Forge BaselineService)

steps.title: Create IdeationBaselineService class
steps.description: Create packages/tuner/src/services/ideation-baseline-service.ts following BaselineService pattern. Implements onPlanQualitySignal handler.

acceptance_criteria.description: Class has constructor(storage: TunerStorage)
onPlanQualitySignal(signal: PlanQualitySignal) method
Skips if signal.source === 'test'
Correlates signal with IdeationOutcome by session_id
Returns early if no matching IdeationOutcome found

architecture.pattern: Similar to BaselineService but triggered by different event

steps.title: Implement Welford baseline updates
steps.description: Implement updateBaselineWithWelford helper that updates mean/stddev for questions, versions, block_utilization, conversation_turns using Welford's online algorithm

acceptance_criteria.description: Uses EMA α=0.1 for mean updates
Uses Welford's algorithm for variance: m2 = m2 + (x - old_mean) * (x - new_mean)
stddev = sqrt(m2 / n)
First sample initializes with stddev=0, sample_count=1
Increments sample_count on each update

algorithms.welford: m2 = m2 + (x - old_mean) * (x - new_mean); stddev = sqrt(m2/n)

steps.title: Implement specialist contribution tracking
steps.description: Update specialist_contribution_rates in baseline for each specialist in IdeationOutcome. Contribution = blocks_created > 0 OR insights_queued > 0.

acceptance_criteria.description: For each specialist in outcome.specialist_contributions, check if contributed
contributed = contrib.blocks_created > 0 OR contrib.insights_queued > 0
Update contribution rate with EMA: new_rate = α * (contributed ? 1 : 0) + (1-α) * old_rate
specialist_contribution_rates is z.record(z.string(), z.number())

architecture.pattern: EMA for contribution rate per specialist

steps.title: Use single 'session_quality' pattern
steps.description: All baselines stored under pattern='session_quality'. No per-topic patterns in v1.

acceptance_criteria.description: storage.getIdeationBaseline('session_quality') for all reads
storage.upsertIdeationBaseline({ pattern: 'session_quality', ... }) for all writes
No topic extraction or per-topic pattern logic in v1

architecture.note: Single global baseline for v1. Per-topic requires higher volume and keyword extraction.

steps.title: Test IdeationBaselineService
steps.description: Unit tests for baseline computation correctness

acceptance_criteria.description: Welford variance converges to correct value for known data set
EMA mean converges to expected value
Specialist contribution rate calculated correctly (EMA of 0/1 indicator)
Baseline skipped when no matching IdeationOutcome
Test-sourced signals are stored but don't update baselines (checked in factory wiring)

steps.title: Wire IdeationBaselineService into factory
steps.description: Add IdeationBaselineService to packages/tuner/src/services/factory.ts, wire plan_quality_signal_received event

acceptance_criteria.description: const ideationBaseline = new IdeationBaselineService(storage) in createTunerServices()
Wire event: collector.on('plan_quality_signal_received', (signal) => { if (signal.source === 'test') return; ideationBaseline.onPlanQualitySignal(signal); })
Add ideationBaseline to TunerServices interface
Return ideationBaseline in factory return object
